site.name: PrintxPDF
site.tagline: Print only what matters. Fix any PDF.
site.description: Turn any web page into a clean printout or PDF, then merge, sign, shrink, protect or convert any PDF. Free, no account, and nearly all of it runs in your tab.
site.footerNote: Independent project. Not affiliated with any other print or PDF service.

home.eyebrow: Free · {count} tools · No account, no card, no watermark
home.lead: Paste a link and keep just the article: no ads, no menus, no comment threads. Print it or save it as a PDF. Or drop in a PDF and merge, split, sign, shrink, black out private details, make scans searchable or convert it. Nearly every tool runs inside this tab, so the file never leaves your computer, and the few jobs that need our server say so before you start.
